purpose: Test whether a completed-bar two-candle absorption/rejection pattern can improve immediate 30-second entry quality without oscillator, channel, FVG, session-range, or previous-day-level logic.
independence: Signal is only two completed candle ranges/bodies and current close location.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes MQL5 Article 12385 — How to use MQL5 to detect candlestick patterns
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Bullish/bearish engulfing requires opposite candle colors, current high above prior high and low below prior low, and current body fully crossing prior body.
Outside-bar sweep of both prior extremes, close beyond prior body, and close in the signal-side outer third of current range, evaluated on confirmed bars.
Outside bar overlaps both previous high and low and represents volatility expansion followed by directed movement.

R037-OER-C02_M1_STRONG_OUTSIDE_THIRD.pattern: outside sweep + prior-body close break + outer-third close

R037-OER-C04_M5_STRONG_OUTSIDE_THIRD.pattern: outside sweep + prior-body close break + outer-third close

timing: completed Bid bar only; first executable tick at/after completed signal-bar right edge

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
